description: arXiv:2609.16752v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Cognitive Field Theory (CFT) proposes that cognition arises from memory-dressed collective dynamics that generate a persistent macroscopic cognitive field. Here we develop a Cognitive Field Network (CFN), a recurrent Transformer in which the organized hidden field re-enters subsequent inference through \[ \Phi_{n+1}=F_{\theta}(X_{n+1},\Phi_n). \]...
